7084-7705-8250.description:
Activate Scarland Thrinax by sacrificing another nonland creature you control
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve Scarland Thrinax's ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Scarland Thrinax by sacrificing the land
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Mole Man triggers, creating a 1/1 green Minion creature token named Moloid with the listed attack trigger
Resolve Scarland Thrinax's ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

803-1669-6871-6879.notablePrerequisites: You have an artifact creature in hand with the mana to cast it.
803-1669-6871-6879.description:
Cast any artifact creature by paying its mana cost.
When the artifact creature enters as an Ally due to Arcane Adaptation, Haru triggers, earthbending the artifact creature, as it's a land due to Toph.
Activate Thaumatog by sacrificing the artifact creature.
When the creature dies, Haru triggers, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When the creature enters as an Ally due to Arcane Adaptation, Haru triggers, earthbending the creature, as it's a land due to Toph.
Resolve the Thaumatog ability, giving Thaumatog +1/+1 until end of turn.
Repeat from step 3.

558-4695-8089.description:
Activate Carrion Howler by paying life.
Repeat step 1 until you have 0 life.
Cast Mister Negative by paying {5}{W}{B} plus commander tax if applicable.
When Mister Negative enters, it triggers, swapping your life total with an opponent's.
The opponent loses the game due to having 0 life.

1479-2841-6157-7893.easyPrerequisites:
It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Bant Panorama.
1479-2841-6157-7893.description:
Fetch a land using Bant Panorama.
When the fetched land enters, Thranduil, Sindarin Liege and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and Thranduil, Sindarin Liege trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Thranduil, Sindarin Liege from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Thranduil, Sindarin Liege triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

2021-2060-4772-7267.description:
Activate Simic Ascendancy by paying {1}{G}{U}, putting four +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler.
Simic Ascendancy triggers, putting growth counters on it.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's second ability by removing three +1/+1 counters from it, adding {1}{G}{U}.
Repeat.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Simic Ascendancy triggers, causing you to win the game.

uses.n: The Legend of Kuruk // Avatar Kuruk

5780-7009-7803.manaNeeded: {20} minus {1} for each creature and artifact you control each turn available
5780-7009-7803.notablePrerequisites:
Avatar Kuruk and Brad Boimler don't have summoning sickness.
An opponent cannot block Avatar Kuruk.
Brad Boimler can attack without dying in combat.
5780-7009-7803.description:
Activate Avatar Kuruk by paying {20} minus {1} for each creature and/or artifact you can tap while activating it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Declare Avatar Kuruk and Brad Boimler as attackers.
When Brad Boimler becomes tapped, he triggers, causing you to place an additional counter this turn whenever counters are placed.
When Avatar Kuruk deals combat damage to a player, Gossip's Talent triggers, blinking Avatar Kuruk and causing it to return to the battlefield as The Legend of Kuruk with two lore counters on it due to Brad Boimler.
The Legend of Kuruk's first and second chapter abilities trigger, causing you to scry 2, draw a card, scry 2 and draw another card.
Move to your next turn. At the beginning of your precombat main phase. The Legend of Kuruk triggers, putting two lore counters on it. Its third chapter ability triggers, causing you to exile it and return it to the battlefield as Avatar Kuruk.
Repeat.

3641-4399-4518-5998.description:
Cast Kor Skyfisher by paying {0} and 2 life due to Defiler of Faith and Grand Arbiter Augustin IV.
Defiler of Faith triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Distinguished Conjurer triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve Kor Skyfisher. When it enters, it and Distinguished Conjurer trigger.
Resolve the Kor Skyfisher trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Distinguished Conjurer trigger, causing you to gain life.
Repeat.
3641-4399-4518-5998.notes: If your life total is below 3 to start, instead pay {W} when casting Kor Skyfisher for the first time.

1895-4399-4518-5468.description:
Cast Kor Skyfisher by paying {0} and 2 life due to Defiler of Faith and Pearl Medallion.
Defiler of Faith triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Kambal triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve Kor Skyfisher. When it enters, it and Kambal trigger.
Resolve the Kor Skyfisher trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Kambal trigger, causing you to gain life.
Repeat.
1895-4399-4518-5468.notes: If your life total is below 3 to start, instead pay {W} when casting Kor Skyfisher for the first time.

5035-5104-5147.description:
Cast Plague of Vermin by paying {6}{B} and choosing to pay any amount of life, creating that many 1/1 Rat creature tokens.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing a Rat.
When the Rat dies, Nadier's Nightblade triggers, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat from step 2 as able.
5035-5104-5147.notes: It's recommended to pay as much life as possible to maximize the amount of lifeloss. If an opponent happens to pay life during casting Plague of Vermin, those additional Rats can also be sacrificed.

4091-6410-7791.notablePrerequisites: You have max speed. You control at least two Goblins.
4091-6410-7791.description:
Activate Howlsquad Heavy by tapping it, adding at least {R}{R}
Activate Aphetto Alchemist by tapping it, targeting Howlsquad Heavy.
Battlemage's Bracers triggers, causing you to pay {1} to copy Aphetto Alchemist's ability, targeting Aphetto Alchemist.
Resolve both Aphetto Alchemist abilities, untapping it and Howlsquad Heavy.
Repeat.

3209-4740-7439.manaNeeded: {G}{G} plus an additional {G} if you don't control an untapped green creature
3209-4740-7439.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is at least 11.
3209-4740-7439.description:
Cast a copy of Channel by paying {G}{G}.
Activate the ability granted by Channel four times by paying 4 life, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Cast Sprout Swarm with buyback by paying {4} and either tapping a green creature if you're able or paying an additional {G}.
Aetherflux Reservoir triggers, causing you to gain 1 life for each spell you've cast this turn.
Resolve Sprout Swarm, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token and returning Sprout Swarm to your hand.
Repeat from step 2.
3209-4740-7439.notes: The life requirement can be lowered if you've cast spells beforehand this turn and/or if you supply additional mana. After the first loop, you'll want to tap the Saproling to reduce Sprout Swarm's cost by {G} via its convoke ability.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

2155-3259-4742.easyPrerequisites: You control a creature with the greatest power among creatures on the battlefield.
2155-3259-4742.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
2155-3259-4742.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Éomer of the Riddermark as attackers.
Éomer of the Riddermark triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

5220-6798-7332.description:
Cast Casey & Raph by paying {4}{R}.
When Casey & Raph enters, it triggers. Choose its first mode targeting yourself.
Holding priority, activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Casey & Raph.
When Casey & Raph dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Casey & Raph onto the top of your library from your graveyard.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Resolve the Casey & Raph trigger from step 2, causing you to exile Casey & Raph from the top of your ability with the ability to cast it from exile without paying its mana cost.
Cast Casey & Raph from exile without paying its mana cost.
Repeat from step 2.

222-527-4460-5256.easyPrerequisites:
You control a Saproling.
You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
222-527-4460-5256.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Altar of Dementia twice by sacrificing Selvala and Slimefoot and Squee.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

224-1863-6756.easyPrerequisites: You control a land that enters the battlefield untapped and that can tap to produce at least {1}.
224-1863-6756.notablePrerequisites: Hearthhull is a creature and has at least two charge counters on it.
224-1863-6756.description:
Activate a land by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Activate Hearthhull by paying {1}, tapping it and sacrificing a land.
If Hearthhull has eight or more charge counters on it, it triggers, causing each opponent to lose 2 life.
Resolve the Hearthhull ability, causing you to draw two cards and allowing you to play an additional land this turn.
Play the land from your graveyard.
When the land enters the battlefield, Retreat to Coralhelm triggers, untapping Hearthhull
Repeat.

3129-4659-5086-5183-6824.easyPrerequisites: Triskelavus has two or more +1/+1 counters on it.
3129-4659-5086-5183-6824.description:
Activate Triskelavus by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate a Triskelavite token by sacrificing it, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain life.
Spider-Man triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Triskelavus
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing another creature token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat from step 1.

3215-5413-6871-6879.description:
Cast Bloodline Pretender by paying {3}.
When Bloodline Pretender enters, Haru triggers, targeting Bloodline Pretender as it is a land due to Toph.
Activate Trenching Steed by sacrificing Bloodline Pretender.
When Bloodline Pretender dies, Haru triggers, returning Bloodline Pretender from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Bloodline Pretender enters, Haru triggers, targeting Bloodline Pretender as it is a land due to Toph.
Resolve the Trenching Steed ability.
Repeat from step 3.

3532-3836-5078-6822.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Lyla triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Repeat.

2478-2866-4986-6798.description:
Cast Mishra's Bauble by paying its mana cost.
Teshar triggers, returning Scrap Trawler from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Mishra's Bauble by tapping and sacrificing it.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Scrap Trawler.
When Scrap Trawler dies, it triggers, returning Mishra's Bauble from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat.

339-413-677-5295.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
When Jegantha enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Repeat.

628-2921-6863--133.notablePrerequisites: Blue has a -1/-1 counter on it.
628-2921-6863--133.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing the other Dinosaur.
When the Dinosaur dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to the -1/-1 counter it will gain from Blue.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat.
628-2921-6863--133.notes: The chosen Dinosaur must not be a Human for the combo to work. Notably, this means you cannot use a creature with changeling for this combo.

1069-3156-3621-4763.notablePrerequisites: You control three or more artifacts, including an Equipment except Demonmail Hauberk.
1069-3156-3621-4763.description:
Activate an equipment except Demonmail Hauberk's equip ability by paying {0}, attaching it to Su-Chi Cave Guard.
Activate Demonmail Hauberk by sacrificing Su-Chi Cave Guard, targeting Koll.
When Su-Chi Cave Guard dies, it and Koll trigger.
Resolve the Su-Chi Cave Guard trigger, adding eight {C}.
Resolve the Koll trigger, returning it from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Demonmail Hauberk ability, attaching it to Koll.
Cast Su-Chi Cave Guard by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

997-3821-5140.notablePrerequisites: You control up to five lands that can tap to produce at least {4}{B}.
997-3821-5140.description:
Activate up to five lands by tapping them, adding at least {4}{B}.
Activate Kenrith's fifth ability by paying {4}{B}, returning Peregrine Drake from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Peregrine Drake enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping up to five lands.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Peregrine Drake, causing you to scry 1.
Repeat.

222-629-2292-4871.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Saproling.
222-629-2292-4871.description:
Activate Viscera Seer twice by sacrificing Gruff Triplets and Slimefoot and Squee.
When Slimefoot and Squee and Gruff Triplets die, Pitiless Plunderer triggers twice and Gruff Triplets' second ability triggers once.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating two Treasure artifact tokens.
Resolve the Gruff Triplets trigger, putting a number of +1/+1 counters equal to Gruff Triplets' power on each creature you control named Gruff Triplets.
Resolve the Viscera Seer abilities, causing you to scry 1 twice.
Activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding two in any combination of {B}, {R} or {G}.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling.
When the creature dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Resolve the Slimefoot and Squee ability, returning it and Gruff Triplets from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Slimefoot and Squue and Gruff Triplets' second ability triggers.
Resolve the Slimefoot and Squee trigger, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Resolve the Gruff Triplets trigger, creating two token copes of it.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing a Gruff Triplets token.
When the Gruff Triplets token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability, causing you to scry 1.
Activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Repeat.

2178-3523-4481.notablePrerequisites:
All Equipments and/or Auras attached to the same creature.
That creature does not have summoning sickness.
2178-3523-4481.description:
Activate the creature by tapping it, dealing damage to an opponent's creature.
The opponent's creature dies due to deathtouch, triggering the second ability granted by Thornbite Staff, untapping your creature.
Repeat until all opponents' creatures die.
Repeat each time a creature enters the battlefield under an opponent's control.

575-1794-4050.notablePrerequisites: You have at least one black card in hand.
575-1794-4050.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Ruthless Ripper, adding one mana of any color.
When Ruthless Ripper dies, Yedora triggers, returning Ruthless Ripper from your graveyard to the battlefield face down as a Forest land.
Activate Ruthless Ripper's morph ability by revealing a black card from your hand, turning it face up.
Repeat.

1818-2173-5010-5256.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is at least 3.
1818-2173-5010-5256.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Golgari Thug.
When Golgari Thug dies, it triggers, putting it from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Cast Golgari Thug from the top of your library by paying 2 life.
When Golgari Thug enters, Healer of the Pride triggers, causing you to gain 2 life.
Repeat.

uses.n: Etali, Primal Conqueror // Etali, Primal Sickness

1235-2178-4147-4294.notablePrerequisites:
Hua Tuo does not have summoning sickness.
Thornbite Staff attached to Hua Tuo.Primal Conquerer.
It is your precombat main phase.
1235-2178-4147-4294.description:
Cast Twinflame by paying {1}{R}, creating a token copy of Etali with haste.
Choose to put the nontoken Etali into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
If Etali is your commander, choose not to return it to the command zone from your graveyard.
The Etali token and Hua Tuo trigger.
Resolve the Hua Tuo trigger untapping it.
Activate Hua Tuo by tapping it, putting Etali on top of your library from your graveyard.
Resolve the Etali token's trigger from step 4, causing you to exile cards from each player's library until you exile a nonland card, with you exiling Etali from your library, and cast Etali and any other nonland cards exiled this way without paying their mana costs.
Choose to put the nontoken Etali into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
If Etali is your commander, choose not to return it to the command zone from your graveyard.
The nontoken Etali and Hua Tuo trigger.
Resolve the Hua Tuo trigger untapping it.
Activate Hua Tuo by tapping it, putting Etali on top of your library from your graveyard.
Resolve the nontoken Etali's trigger from step 10, causing you to exile cards from each player's library until you exile a nonland card, with you exiling Etali from your library, and cast Etali and any other nonland cards exiled this way without paying their mana costs.
Repeat from step 8.

2100-3075-5195.notablePrerequisites: You have at least four experience counters.
2100-3075-5195.description:
Cast Searing Touch with buyback by paying {R}.
Storm-Kiln Artist triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve Searing Touch, dealing 1 damage to any target and returning it to your hand.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {R}.
Repeat.

321-399-2475-3168-4648.description:
Cast Metallic Sliver by paying {0}.
Metallic Sliver enters the battlefield, dealing 1 damage to target player or planeswalker and causing you to gain 1 life.
Essence Sliver triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Activate Metallic Sliver by paying 2 life, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

2178-3500-4410.notablePrerequisites:
All permanents attached to the same creature.
The creature does not have summoning sickness.
2178-3500-4410.description:
Activate the creature by tapping it, dealing 1 damage to any opponent's creature and causing you to gain 1 life.
The opponent's creature dies due to deathtouch, triggering Thornbite Staff, untapping your creature.
Repeat.
